title: WDF extension `capture` 0.1 — capture.json
description: Provenance metadata of a live-page capture (docs/ext-capture.md §4). An extension schema, not part of WDF Core.

capture.description: Version of the capture extension the file conforms to.

url.description: Page address at capture time (http/https only).

userAgent.description: User agent string of the capturing browser.

viewport.description: Layout viewport at capture time (CSS pixels).

mode.description: What was captured: the extracted article or the whole page.
